name: Nextdoor
description: Nextdoor is a neighborhood network that connects verified residents, local businesses, and public agencies with nearby communities. People use it to share local updates, find services and recommendations, and participate in neighborhood conversations.
agentUseSummary: Connect one provider-approved US profile, then let agents inspect that exact server-bound profile, list up to ten own posts, draft locally, and publish one approval-controlled plain-text post without exposing OAuth secrets or raw Publish API access.

capabilities.label: Read selected profile
capabilities.description: Inspect public fields for the exact server-bound verified neighbor or entity profile.

capabilities.label: Read own posts
capabilities.description: List at most ten posts owned by the exact selected profile without pagination.

capabilities.label: Draft plain text
capabilities.description: Normalize and validate one plain-text post locally with no provider side effect.

capabilities.label: Publish plain text
capabilities.description: Publish one exact approval-controlled plain-text post for the selected profile.

allowed.label: Read selected profile
allowed.description: Read provider-correct public fields without exposing the secure profile identifier.

allowed.label: List own posts
allowed.description: List at most ten own posts for the server-bound profile without pagination.

allowed.label: Draft text post
allowed.description: Prepare one normalized post of at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes locally.

approvalRequired.label: Publish text post
approvalRequired.description: Atomically consume approval for one exact text payload and publish without automatic retry.

blocked.label: Block other Nextdoor products
blocked.description: Display Content, Ads/CAPI, Share Plugin, agency, comment, and other separately approved products are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block broader social actions
blocked.description: Community search, other profiles, comments, replies, events, marketplace listings, media, hashtags, smart links, geotags, scheduling, bulk work, edits, deletion, pagination, export, and raw APIs are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block unbound and non-US access
blocked.description: Alternate profile identifiers, raw secure IDs, regional API switching, redirects, arbitrary endpoints, token exposure, oversized responses, and automatic write retry are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Selected-profile reads, bounded own-post reads, and local drafts run automatically; exact text publishing requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected Nextdoor actions run without Relay per-action approval; exact profile binding, scopes, bounds, audits, secret isolation, and no-retry behavior still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts four typed wrappers and attaches the encrypted OAuth token and secure profile identifier only inside Railway's fixed US adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: Nextdoor Publish API is closed beta and requires partner approval, provider-issued confidential credentials, an exact Railway callback, live consent acceptance, and a separately approved official brand asset before one may be bundled.
providerSetup.nextAction: After batch integration, the provider-console task must obtain Publish API partner approval and written brand-use permission, register the exact Railway callback, store the client credentials in Railway staging, confirm US-region eligibility, then validate state, consent, refresh rotation, exact profile binding, bounded reads, Safe approval, dangerous-mode publishing, ambiguous-write no-retry behavior, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Nextdoor documents its closed-beta Publish API, approved partner onboarding, user and entity profiles, and the separate authorization, token, profile, read-post, and create-post operations.
The authorization documentation defines the confidential-client authorization-code flow, registered redirect, and openid, profile:read, post:read, and post:write scopes used by Relay.
Nextdoor documents Basic-authenticated access-token exchange at the global authorization service.
The profile endpoint documents authorized account profiles, secure profile identifiers, entity-profile flags, and entity-page metadata.
The own-post endpoint requires a secure_profile_id and documents post GUID output.
The create-post endpoint documents body_text, an 8192-character maximum, optional secure_profile_id selection, and share_link output.
Nextdoor documents distinct regional API servers; Relay V1 deliberately fixes the existing connector to the US origin until region binding is implemented and accepted.
Nextdoor's brand-use guidance requires permission for third-party logo use, so Relay does not bundle an official logo in this code-only provider slice.
